changelog:
Initial release: Export Claude Code conversations to detailed markdown documents.

- Extracts full dialogue with user questions, model responses, and associated tool operations from internal JSONL files.
- Formats the conversation into a structured markdown file, including all turns, preserved formatting, and operation summaries.
- Adds automatic statistics (total turns, duration, tokens used) and a dual performance evaluation (prompt quality, model performance, strengths/weaknesses, improvement suggestions).
- Supports both English and Chinese; skips internal/system messages and this skill's own invocation.
- Default output to `docs/{YYYY-MM-DD}-conversation.md`, with confirmation and file summary provided to the user.
summary: Export current Claude Code conversation to markdown document with full dialogue context and model operations
